response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_diff, SUM(s.aream2) * 1.0 / SUM(s.volm3) AS av_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(av_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per) SELECT per.fundflux, per.avg_diff, per.av_ratio, per.av_ratio - overall.avg_ratio AS above_average FROM per, overall WHERE per.av_ratio > overall.avg_ratio
